command: cd backend && uv run python -m precompute.beta_hindcast --data <nasa data dir>
method: SPICE DE440, MOON_ME, LT+S; site horizon mask from LOLA (observer 2 m); 10-minute steps. Sunset: whole Sun disc below the terrain horizon. Sunrise: upper limb above it. The Sun-centre crossing is given for reference.
note: BETA. Reported events come from news reports of operator statements, not telemetry, and the reports give no local sunset time. A row says our time is consistent with the reported event, not that it matches it. No DSN figures: the Earth orientation kernel we use covers 2026-2126 only, not 2023-2024.

rows.reported: Intuitive Machines announced the end of the mission with the onset of lunar night
rows.consistency: Our sunset falls on the day the operator announced the end of the mission at lunar night.

rows.reported: ISRO set Vikram into sleep mode around 08:00 IST, 4 Sep 2023
rows.consistency: The lander was put to sleep a few hours before our sunset, while the Sun was still up.

rows.reported: ISRO hoped for the awakening around 22 Sep 2023
rows.consistency: Our sunrise comes about two days before the wake-up target, so the panels had Sun by then.
